summary: The research points one way. In Goose (the to-do list), Hitman (target routines and overheard opportunities), Two Point (pop-up challenges and emergencies) and RimWorld (a colonist close to breaking), players keep watching because they are watching FOR something, and the world keeps giving small readable cues about what to try next. VIRAL has the systemic depth but gives the player no aim and no cues. My audit of all 38 real Gemma stories in P5-P9 shows why the roles feel interchangeable. About 60% of all actions were phone calls (phone 260 of ~430 actions), and every big ending came from 老周 or 小雯. 林市長, 志明 and 美咲 never used a public signature move: 0 statements, 0 notices, 0 cancellations, 0 café closures. Across all eight residents there were only 2 rallies and 4 shop closures. So 'the same sentence to different people' changes only the route the rumour takes to the police or the press, not the kind of outcome. The most valuable day of work is: (1) a Goose-style mischief list, checked off live from validated events. The goals can be ranked by rates measured in those 38 stories: whole town 50%, boomerang 24%, stage 21%, false-rumour-exposes-truth 21%, exposé 18%, strangers meet 16%, police 13%. (2) Role cards showing each resident's verbs and phone web. (3) Prompt 'habits' plus a cheap 'announce' verb, so the mayor, organiser and café owner have public moves they can actually reach. (4) Authored, clearly labelled everyday vignettes that make the town watchable and, like Hitman's overheard conversations, teach the social graph and hint at the true secrets. Mid-run verdict: no free intervention, because the engine runs ahead of playback and an intervention would cut into the climaxes. Offer one optional '補一句' only when a story is about to fizzle, and make the rest of the viewing active through the live checklist and routine countdowns.

proposals.title: 今晚的惡作劇清單 — a Goose-style mischief list checked off live from the log
proposals.player_experience: A small handwritten note sits collapsed in the top-left as a chip: '📝 今晚的惡作劇 2/6'. Opened, it lists six light goals: 📢 讓一句閒話傳遍全鎮（8 個人都聽說） · 🔁 讓謠言繞一圈、變了樣回到第一個人耳裡 · 🚓 讓警察出動 · 🚧/📰 讓舞台被封、或讓小雯發文爆料 · 🤝 讓兩個互不相識的人當面說上話 · 🔍 讓一個假消息碰巧挖出真問題. A seventh, 🏮 讓燈籠節取消, stays hidden until three are done. The player now watches with intent and roots for each step ('come on, 老周, send them!'). The moment a validated event satisfies a goal, a red ✅ stamp thumps onto the note with a sting, without pausing playback. The results card says which goals this run crossed off, plus the closest miss ('差一點：老周想派警力，但把握還不夠'). Over several runs the note fills up, which answers 'why try again?'. There are no rewards, timers or quest log: just a list and a stamp.
proposals.inspired_by: Untitled Goose Game's to-do list. It was built from a reusable list of slapstick gags, makes small acts feel like 'success', and tells you the world is full of toys (gamedeveloper.com 'Road to the IGF: Untitled Goose Game'). Also Hitman challenges and mastery, which give a reason to replay one level many ways (gamecritics 'Hitman's golden opportunities'), and Two Point's three-star goals plus challenges that 'pop up over time' (TheSixthAxis dev interview).
proposals.implementation: New src/town/goals.ts: GOALS = [{id, icon, zh, tier, test(events: SimEvent[], cfg) => {hit, eventId?} }]. Every detector reads only validated events. town = distinct deliver.target equals cfg.active.length. boomerang = a deliver to cfg.seedNpc via face/phone/article from someone the seed resident never talked to or phoned. police = state key 'police'. stage = state key 'stage'. expose = 'article'. shop = state key starting 'shops.' with to='closed'. strangers = a 'talk' event where neither PERSONAS[actor].relations nor PERSONAS[target].relations names the other. truth = reuse story.ts's discovery logic (the '本來在查別的事，卻查出' branch near lines 295-300): an inspect whose data.learned contains a value:true secret, while the seed's first claim is a different topic or false. mayor = 'statement' by mayor (list it only after proposal 3 lands). legend = state festival→cancelled. Measured rates in P5-P9 (n=38): town 19, boomerang 9, stage 8, truth 8, article 7, strangers 6, police 5, shop 2, statement 0, cancel 0. Live check: in director.ts, wherever show.i advances (the step loop around lines 700-705), run the tests on show.order.slice(0, show.i). For new hits set show.stamp = {goal, until} and call sting('goal') (add the cue in sfx.ts). GameUI: a <GoalNote> chip replaces the HUD title card. Results (GameUI.tsx ~241) gets a '這次劃掉了 / 差一點' row (差一點 uses story.ts's existing near-miss and 'rejected.wanted' events). shareCard.ts prints the stamps on the 霧港小報 as 今日戰績. Persist the {goalId: {runId, at, headline}} map in localStorage key 'viral.goals.v1', wrapped in try/catch. Recorded demos (📼) stamp too, marked 'from a recording'.
proposals.risk: Goals the sim can't reach would feel unfair (mayor statement 0/38, cancel 0/38). Show only goals with an observed rate above 0 until proposal 3 is measured, and keep cancel hidden as the legendary goal. Players may type commands ('快去叫警察'). Residents refuse in character (command-mayor), which is a funny lesson rather than a bug. Adding rewards or unlocks would turn it into a quest system, so don't.

proposals.title: Role cards: show each resident as a tool (verbs, credulity, phone web)
proposals.player_experience: Clicking 小雯 shows, in three short lines instead of a bio: '📰 放大器 — 消息到她手上會變成聳動標題' · ability chips 🔍 查帳 📰 發文 · '陌生人的話：半信半疑' · '會打給：美玲、美咲、阿珠'. On the map, thin lines draw from her to each phone contact; dashed lines mark people she can only talk to in person. Clicking 美咲 lights up five lines, which says hub at a glance. 老周 shows 🚓 派警 🚧 封台 and '很難被陌生人說服'. 林市長 shows 📣 聲明 🏮 取消燈籠節 and '最難說服'. Each goal on the mischief list shows the faces of the residents who can directly cause it (🚓 → only 老周). The player immediately understands that the same sentence takes a different road through each person, and starts planning routes: 'tell 美咲, because she phones 老周'.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman: 'every NPC has a purpose' and the level is a set of usable entry points (PC Gamer 'The making of Sapienza'). Two Point and RimWorld: a small cast with a few strong, readable traits (Sylvester's GDC 2017 'Contrarian, Ridiculous, and Impossible Design Methods'). The Sims: visible relationship lines.
proposals.implementation: scenario.ts PUBLIC_BIO (line 191): add a `tag` (e.g. 阿德 '大聲公：什麼都傳，越傳越慌'; 美玲 '情緒放大器：往壞處想，動物優先'; 小雯 '放大器：會查證也會發文'; 美咲 '八卦中樞：電話簿最滿，警長的老朋友'; 老周 '執法者：會親自查、派警、封台'; 林市長 '權力核心：先護形象，可以發聲明或取消燈籠節'; 志明 '推卸大師：心虛時會掩蓋、找市長'; 阿珠 '煽動者：會揪攤商聚集'). Derive verb chips from persona.actions via a VERB_ICON map. Show close_shop/open_shop only as '🔒 可以關店'. Bucket credulity: <0.4 很難說服, <0.6 半信半疑, else 容易相信. Contacts = relations with phone:true. Render in the compose panel (GameUI.tsx 568-598): keep 2 example chips, drop the third, and move '之前的實驗' out. In PlaybackLayer.tsx, reuse the thread <Line> code to draw contact lines from agentFor(selected) to each contact's agent while phase==='compose'. Never use persona.wants or secrets: the mayor's wants text reveals his secret.
proposals.risk: Over-explaining kills discovery, so keep it to three lines and keep relationship details out of view. No secret leaks: tags must stay public knowledge (a test can assert no FACTS keyword appears in PUBLIC_BIO tags).

proposals.title: Give every resident a reachable signature move (persona habits + a cheap 'announce' verb + fewer phone calls)
proposals.player_experience: Telling 林市長's circle that he is afraid of pigeons can now end with him on the town hall steps, giving a stiff press-style denial in front of a gathering crowd ('本人非常喜愛鴿子'). That is the 'make the mayor deny something absurd' payoff. 美咲 announces a rumour to her whole café, and the crowd turns to stare. 志明 slaps a '舞台一切安全' notice on the plaza board. 阿德 closes the bakery and runs door to door. Outcomes now depend visibly on who you told: police, press, PR denial, a café-wide buzz, a protest, a notice. Residents also walk over and talk face to face more often, so the town is full of visible scenes instead of people holding phones far apart.
proposals.inspired_by: Audit finding from 38 real stories (P5-P9). Action counts: mayor 37 phone / 16 tell / 0 statements; organizer 42 phone / 26 tell / 0 notices / 0 inspections; café 34 phone / 0 closures; vendor 2 rallies. Only 老周 and 小雯 ever change the world. Design analogues: Two Point's staff traits with visible behaviour ('irritate everyone with every interaction'; TheSixthAxis), and RimWorld/Sims traits that bias autonomy without overriding it (Sims 2 wants/fears don't override autonomy; strategywiki).
proposals.implementation: (1) scenario.ts PERSONAS (87-168): add `habits`, injected in mind.ts userPrompt after line 141 as `【你的習慣】${p.habits}`. These are characterisation, not orders. 林市長: '對你或燈籠節不利的說法開始在鎮上公開流傳時（有人發文、聚集、貼公告），你習慣親自到鎮公所台階前打官腔澄清'. 志明: '出狀況時你第一反應是貼公告或對外說「一切安全」'. 美咲: '一聽到新鮮事，你會先在店裡跟客人們講'. 阿德: '一緊張就關店跑去當面找人說'. 美玲: '跟動物有關的事，你會放下店務親自去看'. 阿珠: '對鎮公所不滿時你會揪攤商一起去討公道'. (2) New action 'announce' (當場對身邊的人／店裡客人大聲說) for cafe, baker, vendor, mayor, organizer. Add it to types.ts ActionKind, mind.ts ACTION_ZH (line 32) and validate.ts NEEDS_MESSAGE (line 12). It needs cites, like public_statement. Engine exec (engine.ts ~426) gets a new case: busy 2 min, emit 'announce', then spread(ev, t, n.place, text, 'crowd', n.p.id, {except:[n.p.id], delay:[8,30], p:0.45, claims}). Residents on the spot hear it at once; others hear it later at stranger trust (wide but weak, against phone's narrow but trusted). director.ts: crowd agents within 8 m turn to face the speaker with 😮/👂 bubbles. story.ts: '📣 美咲當眾說了' as a low-priority headline. (3) Edit the ACTION_ZH phone description: '打電話（適合急事或對方離你很遠；重要的事當面說比較容易讓人相信）'. (4) Validate with one batch of the 6 dramatic inputs plus 2 new ones ('聽說市長很怕鴿子' → 美咲; '舞台好像在晃' → 志明). Accept if statements, notices or announces appear and no single ending exceeds ~40%. Cost ≈ 8 × US$0.0012.
proposals.risk: Could create a new attractor (every story ends with the mayor's statement), so measure ending distribution as in P3. Prompt edits need a fresh lab batch, which per the owner's memory note must wait until they're not playtesting. 'announce' increases fan-out (more listeners, more decisions), but the global 22-decision cap bounds cost and time.

proposals.title: 鎮上日常 — authored everyday vignettes that make the town watchable before and during the story
proposals.player_experience: Before the player whispers anything, small two-actor skits play every 20-30 s near the camera, each 6-10 s, with short muted bubbles tagged 「日常」. 阿珠 waves a fee receipt at 志明 by the stage: 「翻倍？你們怎麼不去搶！」, and 志明 shrinks back. 志明 glances around, then shoves a wobbly strut back into place. 阿德 bangs the oven door and a puff of black smoke escapes the chimney: 「老傢伙，今晚撐住啊」. 老周 walks into the café and 美咲 hands him a coffee before he orders. 美玲 feeds the caged pigeons and sighs. 林市長 rehearses his speech on the steps; a pigeon lands on his shoulder and he calmly pats it. 小雯 photographs a cat dramatically, mutters 「流量…」, and gets shooed off by 老周. Two aunties whisper and point at the town hall. A kid's lantern sticks in a tree and 美玲 helps. The shiba steals a dropped baguette. Watching is fun on its own, and it quietly teaches who likes whom and where the real cracks are. During long model waits, the 'meanwhile' cutaway plays one of these (crowd and pets only) instead of a dozing cat.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman NPC routines and overheard conversations, which make the level both alive and readable (Hitman wiki / gamecritics). Goose: the groundskeeper's visible routine, and stealing was 'funnier when people weren't looking' (gamedeveloper.com IGF piece). RimWorld chitchat/slight/insult interactions as constant low-level social texture (rimworldwiki 'Social'). Tarn Adams' test that a system is worth it when 'a little narrative' forms, e.g. barristers interrupted by a rude dog (PC Gamer 2026).
proposals.implementation: New src/town/vignettes.ts: VIGNETTES: {id, cast: (post | 'crowd:kid' | 'pet:dog')[], hours?: [h0,h1], steps: ({goto}|{face}|{act: ActKind}|{say: string, dur}|{wait})[], clue?}[]. A runner in the crowd frame loop picks an eligible vignette near controls.target (≤35 m, fallback anywhere). It uses crowdSim scriptGoto/scriptHold/perform/releaseScript (crowdSim.ts 333-362, 601), with a per-vignette timeout and release. Says.tsx gets a 'daily' bubble style: smaller, beige, no belief bar, corner tag 「日常」. Rules, enforced by a unit test: never touch engine state; spoken lines carry no fact content (hints are physical only: strut, smoke, calm pigeon); never contradict FACTS (the mayor is not afraid of pigeons); never claim a relation that isn't in PERSONAS.relations. Core residents perform only in explore/compose. During playback only crowd and pets, and never anyone in show.order. Replace director.ts meanwhileSpot (296-305) with 'start a crowd/pet vignette near a spot' and label it '同一時間，鎮上日常：…'. In explore the camera never auto-moves: an optional '👀 阿珠又在找志明理論' chip sets camRequest to the spot. Start with ~12 vignettes.
proposals.risk: Players could mistake authored skits for the Gemma story. Mitigate with a distinct bubble style and 「日常」 tag, core residents only before the whisper, and no story topics in the lines. Choreography can jam on paths, so timeout and release. Tone drift: keep lines under 15 characters and in character.

proposals.title: 小道消息 notebook — Hitman-style opportunity hints harvested from vignettes
proposals.player_experience: When the player watches a vignette that shows something real, a one-line clue drops into a 🔎 notebook chip. Examples: '志明好像很怕別人碰舞台左後方那根支架', '阿德的烤箱冒黑煙', '老周每天都去美咲店裡喝咖啡（老朋友）', '阿珠跟志明為攤位費吵過'. When the player opens a resident's card, relevant clues show under it ('你注意到：…'). Nothing is auto-filled; the player still writes the sentence. The clues turn free text into free PLAY ('I saw 志明 panic about the strut, so let me get the police near the stage'), and pay off the 'make a false rumour expose a real problem' goal (lantern→stage and car→budget did exactly this in 8 of 38 real runs).
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman's opportunities, which start from eavesdropped NPC conversations and come with three guidance levels from hidden to full waypoints (gamecritics). Hitman mission stories reveal the target's personality. The Sims' visible wants.
proposals.implementation: VIGNETTES entries carry clue?: {zh, about: NpcId[], ref: FactId | 'relation'}. On a vignette's final step, add the clue to the ui store and localStorage 'viral.clues.v1' (try/catch). The GameUI compose panel lists clues where about includes ui.selected. A small chip shows '🔎 3'. Test: every clue's ref is a FACTS entry with value:true or an existing relation, so clues can never be false. Keep the Hitman 'guidance level' idea as a later toggle (off = no notebook).
proposals.risk: Could make the secrets too easy. Phrase clues as observations, not conclusions. The payoff still depends on who hears what and on Gemma's variance (P7 vs P8 on the same config: 5/6 vs 2/6 world changes).

proposals.title: 今晚行程 — show the routine meetings as anticipation, and add two natural crossings
proposals.player_experience: A thin strip on the playback time bar shows tonight's schedule as icons: 16:30 🍞 阿德→咖啡廳, 17:00 🚧 老周到舞台巡查, 17:30 🎤 小雯採訪市長, 18:00 💐 美玲送花, 18:30 💰 阿珠繳費, 18:45 🤝 市長巡攤位, 19:00 👧 美咲帶女兒彩排, 20:00 🏮. Ten game-minutes before a meeting where one of the pair is currently carrying a belief, a chip pops up with both faces: '⏰ 再 10 分鐘：老周要去舞台找志明巡查'. That is the bomb under the table. The player leans in: will 志明 crack? The schedule is visible before whispering, so players learn timing ('get 志明 nervous before 17:00'). Passed meetings that didn't come up grey out honestly.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman target routines, where knowing the schedule creates plans and anticipation. The groundskeeper's predictable routine in Goose. RimWorld's storyteller pacing of beats. The 'suspense beats surprise' principle already in the project's research.
proposals.implementation: GameUI Controls (112-158): render ROUTINE marks (scenario.ts 219) on the progress bar. In director.ts, compute 'upcoming' from show.gameT and each resident's latest belief event already played (playback state, no engine peeking). Show the chip only if one of the pair carries a ≥0.3 belief, and say nothing about whether it will come up. Add two entries to ROUTINE: {at:225, who:'mayor', with:'vendor', place:'stall', zh:'林市長到攤位區巡視、跟攤商握手', about:['policy','scandal','personal','event']} and {at:240, who:'cafe', with:'organizer', place:'stage', zh:'美咲帶女兒到舞台彩排', about:['safety','event','health']}. The second pair has no relation entries, so it also feeds the 🤝 strangers goal; the first puts the mayor face to face with the angriest resident in public, a natural setting for a statement. Engine logic is unchanged: meetings only play out when someone carries a belief of that kind.
proposals.risk: The P3 attractor could return (the 17:00 walk-through drove 3 of 5 stories to the stage). The new café-stage meeting could raise stage closures, already the most common ending (8/38). Measure in the proposal 3 batch, and narrow `about` if the stage share goes above ~40%.

proposals.title: 補一句 — one optional extra whisper, offered only when the story is about to fizzle (mid-run verdict)
proposals.player_experience: When nothing is left to happen (no one deciding, no story tasks, no routine meeting anyone has a reason to raise), a chip slides up while the last beat plays: '🔥 故事快熄火了 — 要再對誰耳語一句嗎？（限一次）'. It shows the 8 faces and a 12-second ring. If the player ignores it, the story ends as now. If they pick someone, a mini compose box opens and the story continues in the same evening: the first listener still remembers the odd stranger (林市長 is now suspicious; 美咲 kept it to herself). The results card shows it honestly: '你又對小雯說：…'. Judgement by entertainment. Pure watching is right for strong chains: 3-6 minutes of content that a prompt would interrupt. It is dead for fizzles: 9 of 38 real stories reached at most 2 people, and weak inputs end in 4-14 s. Any-time intervention is rejected: the engine runs ahead of playback (the frontier), so an injection at the viewer's moment would contradict events already computed, and it would cut into climaxes. Prediction bets add UI for little payoff. The rest of the 'active watching' comes from the checklist (1) and countdowns (6), which cost no latency.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point emergencies: an optional offer you can accept or ignore (Sega Retro: emergency patients you 'choose whether to attempt' within a time limit). Plague Inc's mid-run evolve decisions when the world reacts. RimWorld's storyteller noticing a lull. Goose's 'try something, watch the reaction, try another thing' loop.
proposals.implementation: engine.ts: mark routine queue items with routine:true and attach their r (lines 652-675). In the main loop (693-715), when !secondUsed && cfg.onQuiet && every queued item is routine && no routine item would fire (reuse carried(a, r.about) ?? carried(b, r.about), line 654) && now < 240, run `const w = await cfg.onQuiet(now)` (it resolves null after 12 s untouched, or when the player cancels). If given, emit('seed', now+1, …, {data:{text, second:true}}) and deliver(npcs.get(w.npc), 'unknown', 'seed', 'inform', w.text, [], now+1, ev). The 22-decision cap stays shared. GameUI start() (447) passes onQuiet; it resolves the promise from a <SecondWhisper> chip shown only when show.stalled and playback is within ~5 s of the frontier. story.ts: spine from the first seed; the second seed is shown as a player beat, and 'drift' is checked against both sentences. Put it behind a flag and compare with pure watching in 3 human sessions (did they use it? did they retry more?).
proposals.risk: It weakens the 'I only said ONE sentence' identity, so name it 補一句 and print it on the card and newspaper. It adds 5-15 s of model wait at a low-energy moment. Multi-seed logic touches story-card honesty tests, so add cases. If testers ignore it, cut it and rely on What If.

proposals.title: Results that hand you the next experiment (near misses → contrasting What If)
proposals.player_experience: The results card opens with the headline, the goals crossed off this run, and two big buttons under '下一次試試'. They are chosen from what happened, never from a predicted outcome. Examples: '老周信了 45%，差一點派警 — 這次讓他從老朋友美咲那裡聽到？' (same sentence → 美咲), or '消息沒碰到任何有權力的人 — 給放大器小雯？'. The full chain and tech details collapse under '看完整經過'. Retrying becomes a hypothesis, not a reroll.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman's replay loop (first runs teach the level, later runs try new routes; mastery challenges; gamecritics). RimWorld and Dwarf Fortress's 'failed runs are still stories' (Sylvester GDC 2017 via habrador.com). Players trading DF stories (Gamasutra 2008 interview).
proposals.implementation: story.ts already computes the near miss ('差一點', surest resident plus relevant move) and refusal beats ('rejected' with data.wanted). Add suggestNext(run): if a refusal or a near miss exists, pick the near-miss resident's highest-trust contact with phone:true from PERSONAS.relations (e.g. police→cafe 0.7). If no power holder was reached, suggest the hub (cafe) or the amplifier (journalist), whichever wasn't the seed. Otherwise suggest the resident whose role tag contrasts most with the seed's. In GameUI Results (241-361), these feed the existing onWhatIf(npc, sentence) and move the full What If list (line 335) below. Wrap the chain and TechDecisions in <details>.
proposals.risk: Suggestions could read as a walkthrough, so phrase them as 試試. Gemma's variance keeps the outcome uncertain. Never state a predicted ending.

proposals.title: UI diet + 霧港耳語 ticker (Plague Inc newsreel) in place of town statistics
proposals.player_experience: The screen belongs to the town. In explore, the two big cards become a small pill '霧港鎮 · 15:42 · 燈籠節倒數 4:18' plus a one-line ticker underneath. The ticker rotates silly town-radio items that never mention story topics ('海鷗又搶走一支熱狗', '鎮公所提醒：燈籠不是帽子', '書店老闆堅稱聽見貓說話'), plus routine notes ('16:30 阿德會送麵包去咖啡廳'). As the story grows, items from validated events push the silly ones out ('📞 美咲打給老周：舞台好像…', '🚓 警察出動到麵包店'), so the share of story items shows how viral it went. During playback, one 'what is happening now' line replaces the stacked caption bar, meanwhile label and replay note. Time slider, speed and camera presets move into a ⋯ drawer.
proposals.inspired_by: Plague Inc.'s news feed. Random headlines are crowded out and 'eventually stop' as plague headlines become 'the only news displayed' (plagueinc.wiki.gg 'News'). Two Point Hospital's PA announcer jokes as ambient flavour. The owner's critique (tool-like panels).
proposals.implementation: TownScene.tsx Hud (197-277): delete the population and pet stats lines (226-230) and the title block (223-224). Render <Pill> + <Ticker>, and move the slider, speeds and VIEWS into a collapsible drawer (keep the H toggle). New src/town/ticker.ts: TOWN_RADIO: string[] authored, with a unit test that bans topic keywords (鴿, 舞台, 預算, 烤箱, 燈籠, 警, 攤位費). storyItems(show) = played events of type phone/talk/article/statement/state/gather/notice, up to show.i only (never ahead of playback). Mix ratio = min(1, storyCount/6). GameUI CaptionBar (74) and the meanwhile/replayNote banners (564-566, 630-634) become one NowLine component. The simulating modal (612-621) becomes a small chip with no call counters (keep counters in a dev panel).
proposals.risk: Hiding the time slider removes a toy some like, so keep it in the drawer. Ticker honesty: the radio items must never look like residents' beliefs (no names of core residents, no story topics), enforced by the test.

proposals.title: Night readability: calmer lanterns and bloom, fill light on faces
proposals.player_experience: At 19:00-20:00 the plaza still glows festive, but faces, gestures and name tags read clearly. Lanterns look like warm points instead of blown-out orbs eating the actors.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point animates and lights for readability 'from a distance' (TheSixthAxis). Goose's 'the conflict is always easy to read'. The owner's critique.
proposals.implementation: clock.ts updateGlow (123-131): lanterns 0.25+lightsOn*(1.5±0.2) → 0.2+lightsOn*(0.95±0.1); lamp 2.6 → 1.6; window 1.25 → 0.9. TownScene.tsx Bloom (line 323): intensity 0.9 → 0.45, luminanceThreshold 1 → 1.05, luminanceSmoothing 0.2 → 0.35. Vignette darkness 0.45 → 0.3 after 18:30 (drive it from skyAt().lightsOn). Add a camera-relative soft directional fill (no shadows, intensity 0.35*lightsOn) in SunAndSky so faces toward the camera get light. Optionally use a slightly warmer, brighter night ground colour in KEYS[4] (line 44). Check with screenshots at 17:00, 19:00 and 19:45 in LITE and full modes.
proposals.risk: Could lose festival mood. Keep lantern colours saturated and lower only intensity and halo. Perf is unchanged (one extra light, no shadows).

proposals.title: Readable core residents: silhouette, signature prop, stance and gait
proposals.player_experience: From the default camera height you can name every core resident without tags. 阿德: tall chef toque and a baguette under his arm, round and bouncy. 美玲: wide straw hat with a flower and a watering can, small careful steps. 小雯: beret, camera on a strap and a notebook, quick steps with head swivels. 美咲: coffee pot and headband, bouncy, chatty idle. 老周: peaked cap with a badge, hands behind his back, slow heavy stride, slightly broader. 林市長: red sash and slick hair, chest out, slow ceremonial walk. 志明: yellow hard hat, clipboard and walkie, always hurrying, checks his watch when idle. 阿珠: headband and takoyaki pick, arms akimbo, stomping walk. Gemma's chosen acts read more strongly because each body has its own baseline.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point characters: exaggerated props and animation built to read at a distance (TheSixthAxis). The Sims and Goose silhouettes. The owner's critique that core NPCs look like ordinary residents.
proposals.implementation: crowdSim.ts Look (11-28): add signature?: 'toque_baguette' | 'sunhat_can' | 'beret_camera' | 'pot_band' | 'badge_cap' | 'sash' | 'hardhat_clipboard' | 'band_pick' and gait?: {speedMul, bob, swing, idle: 'handsBehind'|'akimbo'|'watch'|…}. Set them where core residents are spawned: shopkeepers in the worker() calls (lines 212-226, keyed by b.id via NPC_POST in director.ts line 15), the mayor (230), the organizer (232), and the vendor at stall-2 (209). Crowd.tsx: build the props as a few low-poly meshes per character (instanced is unnecessary for 8), and apply gait in the existing walk and pose code. Keep the art style: same palette and flat shading.
proposals.risk: Clutter at close range; scale the props carefully. Pose layering conflicts with the 12-act library, so let acts override the idle stance. Small perf cost (8 characters).

proposals.title: Dramatic landmark stages and state-reactive life props
proposals.player_experience: Each district reads as a stage for a kind of drama. The town hall gets steps, two flags and a small press podium, where statements and announcements happen with a crowd semicircle. The plaza gets a bigger notice board, a festival countdown board and bunting. The shopping street gets chalkboards outside each shop with daily specials that flip to '暫停營業' when a shop really closes. 阿珠's stall carries a hand-painted '攤位費翻倍！' sign (public info). The stage area gets temporary folding tables and lantern-hanging workers on ladders. The harbour gets crate stacks, fish-market tables and a crane. The world change from a closed shop or a closed stage becomes visible on the set itself, not only in a caption.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point rooms and props as readable stages. Hitman landmarks double as opportunity sites. Goose: every prop is a toy. The owner's critique that the composition is too even.
proposals.implementation: Props.tsx / StreetProps.tsx: targeted additions positioned from layout.ts BUILDINGS (townhall x0 z-30.6; bakery/flower/cafe/mart/seafood; STAGE; STALLS). Instance pots, crates and chairs. Chalkboards use a canvas texture (textures.ts signTexture pattern) whose text is chosen from show's played world state, so it updates during playback only when the 'state' event plays. The podium position becomes the director's statement/announce anchor (director.ts statement shot). Add 3-4 lantern-hanger crowd workers using the existing 'work'/job mode (crowdSim.ts 239-245 dockworker pattern).
proposals.risk: Visual clutter and draw calls, so instance and cap ~150 small props. Reactive chalkboards must follow playback time, not the engine frontier, or they'd spoil what's coming.

proposals.title: Pets and bystanders as comedic amplifiers of real events
proposals.player_experience: When 阿珠 stomps off angrily, the shiba trots after her barking. When officers arrive, a kid salutes and two others follow them. A cat bolts off the stage when the tape goes up. When the vendors rally, three kids march behind chanting with paper lanterns. The big beats get a laugh and a sense that the whole town noticed, without inventing any beliefs.
proposals.inspired_by: Tarn Adams' 'barristers interrupted by a rude dog' test for emergent narrative (PC Gamer 2026). Goose's NPC reactions as the comedy engine (PC Gamer interview with Nico Disseldorp). Two Point's micro-behaviours where patients affect each other (TheSixthAxis).
proposals.implementation: director.ts already has 'bystanders react to real public changes only' (around 307). Extend that hook. On a 'state', 'gather', police 'arrive', or a stomp/angry act played on a core resident, find pets within 10 m (petSim pets.list) and call scare() (petSim.ts 427) or a new follow(petId, agent, 8 s). For 1-3 kids within 12 m (look.who==='kid'), call perform(a, 'salute'|'bounce') or a scriptGoto trailing the actor, then releaseScript. Presentation only: never emits events and never touches minds.
proposals.risk: Overuse becomes noise, so cap at one reaction per beat and skip when the camera is in a close shot of a conversation.
